Job Description

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom-and-pop shops to approximately 70% of the S&P 500. We are the number one issuer of small business cards, the industry leader in corporate T&E and represent approximately 40% of the company’s total revenues. Our vision is to be essential to our customers’ businesses every day. We do that by offering a diverse suite of payment and cashflow tools our customers need to run and grow their businesses, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage their financial and payment needs.

Responsibilities

This role will be focused on expanding the core APIs to enable a robust business to business feature set
This role requires a blend of a highly technical skillset with deep business acumen, with the expectation of being able to make technical decisions fast to deliver on business strategy to drive more adoption and revenue
Leads, mentors, and coaches Senior Software Engineers and teams, fostering a culture of excellence, continuous professional growth, and knowledge sharing within the software engineering community
Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and implement talent acquisition and retention strategies, ensuring the organization attracts and retains top talent
Directs and oversees the successful development, deployment, support, and monitoring of software across various environments
Leads multiple software product development teams to realize the company's technology vision and strategy in a scalable, iterative environment
Drives innovation and experimentation to deliver software solutions that meet or exceed customer and partner expectations
Shares technology domain expertise with architects and specialists across multiple organizations to enhance technical solutions
Ensures frictionless automated delivery processes and empowers teams to succeed at scale
Collaborates with business and technology partners to motivate change and execute product roadmaps
Collaborates and co-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives

Education

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
Knowledge of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, NoSQL, and relational databases
Knowledge of the core tools used in the planning, analyzing, crafting, building, testing, configuring, and maintaining of assigned application(s)

Work Experience

Deep understanding of how to leverage AI tooling to enhance productivity Kotlin, Ktor, AWS, and API development
Software engineering and development experience or a related job
Experience in leading and managing software engineering teams, providing technical leadership and mentorship
Experience in collaborating with senior stakeholders to drive software strategy and innovation
Expertise in application design, software development, and automated testing
Experience in distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases
Experience in Agile software development methodologies and practices such as Scrum/Kanban, iterations, user stories
Experience in automation testing and documentation (i.e. automated, functional, and performance)

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the U.S. is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

added.title: Director, Software Engineering (Network Platform)
added.description:
As a Capital One Director of Software Engineering, you'll work on everything from customer-facing web and mobile applications using cutting-edge open source frameworks, to highly-available RESTful microservices, to back-end Java based systems and Machine learning models using the hottest techniques in Big Data. You'll bring solid experience in emerging and traditional technologies such as: node.js, Java, GO, AngularJS, React, Python, REST, JSON, XML, Ruby, Perl, NoSQL databases, relational databases, Spark, Artifactory, Maven, iOS, Android, and AWS/Cloud Infrastructure to name a few.

The Director, Software Engineering (Network Platform Development) will be responsible for Capital One network design and transformation, fundamentally shifting the Network infrastructure towards a proactive, Intent Based Network architecture framework, built on Infrastructure-as-Code principles.This leader will focus on accelerating automation, AI integration, innovation-first engineering discipline and engineering practice maturity.

The Director will be responsible for building and scaling a specialized team focused on automating a complex technology landscape, standardizing engineering configurations, and consolidating overlapping vendor functions. By embedding built-in governance, maximizing technological efficiency, and integrating agentic AI technologies, this leader will drive continuous optimization—systematically upskilling the team toward advanced automation capabilities. This is a high-impact position for a transformative leader ready to own the network transformation engineering initiative and replace manual operational processes with cutting-edge network development and intelligent automation.

Lead, manage and grow multiple teams of product focused software engineers
Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of engineers on your team.

Continuously improve software engineering practices

Lead the craftsmanship, availability, resilience, and scalability of your solutions
Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, experiment with and learn new technologies, participate in internal & external technology communities, and mentor other members of the engineering community
Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity
Work across to improve the velocity of your and other teams
Lead efforts to deploy new and existing applications into AWS environments
Break existing monolithic applications into micro service architectures and build new microservices

added.title: Director of Engineering – User Experience
added.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

As Director of Engineering – User Experience, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Scout Motors' customer facing Digital Products on Web and Mobile. You will lead multiple engineering teams delivering the customer facing web experience for product, brand, and growth areas, and interface with our Sales Engineering team on building an end-to-end checkout process. In addition, this role will lead a mobile engineering team responsible for the Scout mobile vehicle companion that includes the Vehicle controls and interactions along so a Scout customer purchasing experience. You will partner closely with Product, UX, Operations, Sales, Marketing, IT, Vehicle Engineering and external partners to deliver these critical applications and solutions supporting Scout's direct-to-consumer business.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Direct engineering efforts supporting the complete customer lifecycle, from brand discovery and vehicle purchase through delivery, ownership, service engagement, accessories, and long-term customer relationship management.
Direct engineering teams responsible for the mobile application that comprises customer commercial experiences along with vehicle companion controls and functions.
Define and execute engineering strategy, web front-end architecture, and technical roadmaps aligned with Digital Product Engineering and company objectives.
Partner with Growth, Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams to drive experimentation, A/B testing, personalization, and conversion optimization across customer acquisition and e-commerce funnels.
Partner with senior leaders across Product, Finance, Operations, Vehicle Engineering, IT, Legal, and external partners to align priorities, resolve complex cross-functional challenges, and drive business outcomes.
Build and develop engineering leaders, including Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and Staff Engineers, while establishing succession plans and organizational capabilities that scale with business growth.
Drive continuous improvement in Core Web Vitals, application responsiveness, reliability, and site availability to deliver best-in-class customer experiences.
Own operational planning, capacity management, vendor engagements, and delivery execution across the Customer Experience Engineering organization.
Hire, coach, and grow engineering leaders while building a strong engineering culture.
Influence AI-assisted software development and modern engineering practices to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Influence executive decision-making through clear communication of engineering strategy, platform investments, business tradeoffs, organizational and engineering health, delivery risk, and long-term technology direction.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer obsession.
Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams to ensure customer-facing applications meet security, privacy, regulatory, and data governance requirements.
Lead the design and evolution of digital platforms capable of supporting future regional expansion, multiple markets, localized experiences, payment methods, and evolving regulatory requirements.
Own engineering standards and investment priorities for web performance, accessibility, SEO, resiliency, and overall digital experience quality across customer-facing web properties.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across digital commerce, customer engagement, application performance, reliability, conversion, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Champion a data-driven engineering culture leveraging behavioral analytics, customer insights, experimentation, application telemetry, and operational metrics to guide investment decisions and product improvements.
Drive investments in platform architecture, engineering excellence, automation, and self-service capabilities that enable rapid product innovation, operational efficiency, and business scalability.
Develop and execute the long-term engineering roadmap for customer-facing platforms, APIs, content management systems, experimentation frameworks, observability, and developer experience capabilities, while driving investments in platform architecture, automation, engineering excellence, and self-service tooling.
Partner closely with Vehicle Software Engineering and Platform teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable integrations between customer-facing mobile applications and vehicle systems.
Define the engineering vision for mobile applications as a core component of the vehicle ownership experience, enabling vehicle access, vehicle controls, notifications, charging management, service interactions, and connected customer experiences.
Lead platform capabilities supporting customer identity, authentication, account management, customer profiles, and seamless user experiences across web, mobile, and connected digital touchpoints.
Own engineering strategy and execution for digital commerce experiences including vehicle configuration, reservation flows, checkout, financing, trade-in, delivery scheduling, and post-purchase customer journeys.
Translate company growth objectives, customer experience goals, and business priorities into engineering investment strategies and execution plans.
Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure highly available, resilient, and scalable customer-facing digital services.
Establish and monitor engineering health metrics including delivery predictability, platform reliability, developer productivity, quality, and operational excellence.
Own prioritization, sequencing, and execution planning across customer-facing web and mobile engineering portfolios to ensure alignment with company objectives and resource constraints.

Location & Travel Expectations

This role requires 1-3 days per week in office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.
Travel: Occasional travel for workshops, planning sessions, vendor meetings, testing events, and company events.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science or related field.
12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading multiple engineering teams or engineering managers within a complex technology organization.
Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy, drive organizational alignment, and deliver outcomes across multiple cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong background in web front-end development frameworks, responsive UI, in building highly interactive and performant web-based product marketing and e-commerce solutions.
Background and familiarity in mobile application frameworks on iOS and Android.
Experience with web and mobile analytics tools to improve customer engagement and user experience.
Experience leading managers, senior managers, principal engineers, and cross-functional engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing engineering organization including hiring, mentoring, and growing engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
Experience owning organizational planning, prioritization, resource management, and large-scale technology investments.
Experience driving AI-assisted engineering practices and engineering productivity.
Strong understanding of performance engineering, accessibility standards, SEO best practices, and modern customer experience technologies.
Experience implementing experimentation platforms, A/B testing strategies, analytics frameworks, and data-driven decision-making processes.
Experience building and scaling consumer-facing digital commerce platforms with accountability for customer acquisition, conversion, engagement, and retention outcomes.

Nice to Have

Automotive, ecommerce, or retail platform experience.
Experience with payments, financing, CRM, ERP, DMS, or order management systems.
Experience building AI-enabled engineering organizations.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.

Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

Role And Team

As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

Daily Work

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred:
Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary and stock option package
Performance-based incentive compensation
Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.
All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year
Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.

Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. MedInsight is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead the next phase of our technology and organizational evolution. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, this executive will lead an approximately 100-person global engineering organization spanning application development, data engineering, platform engineering, AI, and technical operations.

The VP will shape engineering strategy, strengthen leadership and operating capabilities, modernize core platforms, improve delivery predictability, and accelerate responsible AI-enabled innovation. This is an opportunity to influence product and business strategy while building the engineering organization required to support a market-leading healthcare analytics business.

Define and execute a long-term engineering strategy aligned with MedInsight's business and product objectives.
Improve engineering velocity, delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, testing, and operational excellence.
Establish consistent engineering standards, architecture practices, automation, observability, and scalable development processes.
Accelerate responsible adoption of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies across products, engineering, and operations.

Earn the enterprise's trust. Make every agent action reproducible, auditable, and explainable to the bar a regulated aerospace and defense IT department will accept, with humans in the loop where it counts.

Why Pelico

A true founder mandate: real ownership, meaningful equity, and the room to build the platform and the team on your terms.
The highest-stakes seat here. You build it for customers like Airbus and Safran, at the scale of their global operations, and the moat is something competitors cannot copy: we own both the factory simulation and the scoreboard that says whether an agent actually helped.
